name: Tracht Parade & Shoe-Tapping Gathering
beschreibung: The largest Schuhplattler gathering in Tyrol takes place in Mayrhofen. Hundreds of traditional costume societies from all across Austria and the Alpine region parade through the streets. Spectacular Schuhplattler performances, whip cracking and lively Zillertal music make this day a magnificent celebration of Alpine folk culture.
kurzbeschreibung: Hundreds of Schuhplattler and folk dance clubs gather for Tirol’s largest cultural festival in Mayrhofen.
